meaning:
a gem, precious stone, emerald (Josephus)
Also means: bar.qat (בָּֽרְקַת "gem" H1304B)

elsewhere.note: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;
You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and beryl. Gold…
